_comment: mp-sync: sample 8-point FOV series (X/Y in 0–1 → stim_mode=slm ok). Swap for your .gpl/.xml.
_group_size_note: Each random group has at least 3 points (enforced).
_powers_note: Same numbers as PV UI UncagingLaserPower (0–100+), NOT 0–1 fractions.
_images_note: Each mp-sync run → trial_images/run_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS/tXXXX_pYYY/{f0,f1,dff}.png (needs relay --grab); gray=pool, cyan/lime=fired group
_stim_mode_note: slm only if X/Y in 0–1; .gpl galvo lists auto-fallback to series/-lmp/-mp
_slm_pack_note: true=one -MarkAllPoints per power (all groups packed); false=one -MarkAllPoints per group
_use_3d_note: Match series Use3D; true when points have nonzero Z
_optics_note: 512×512 @ 2.220 µm/px → 1136.7 µm FOV; fov_width_um drives -slm spiral fraction
_interval_note: Interval ≈ Duration + Inter Point Delay; not a script/XML field
